summary: Open-source workspace that combines docs, whiteboards, and knowledge organization in one self-hosted app.
overview:
AFFiNE brings documents, whiteboards, and structured knowledge into one workspace. Teams can write notes, organize pages, and collaborate visually without switching between multiple tools.

The self-hosted edition is suitable for users who want control over deployment, storage, and upgrade timing while keeping the official product experience.
description:
AFFiNE is an all-in-one knowledge and collaboration workspace. It combines rich-text documents, whiteboards, and content organization into a unified interface that works well for personal knowledge management and team collaboration.

This package deploys the official AFFiNE server with PostgreSQL and Redis. It follows the upstream 0.27 self-hosting model, including the migration job and config.json-based runtime configuration.

Typical use cases include team notes, project documentation, lightweight visual planning, and self-hosted knowledge bases.
